# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Plans next test increment |
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Runs one TDD cycle with retries |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | Python TDD execution pod |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | LLM code generation for TDD phases |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Container execution orchestrator |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Rootless Podman container runner |
| AutonomousTDDAgent | src/agents/autonomous_tdd_agent.py | Full autonomous TDD agent |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src/agents/gherkin_feature_bridge.py | Parses .feature files |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter.py | Blocks forbidden imports |
| RedundancyPreChecker | src/agents/redundancy_checker.py | Pre-checks test redundancy |
| TestReviewAgent | src/agents/test_review_agent.py | Validates test quality |
| TDDFailureRecorder | src/agents/tdd_failure_recorder.py | Records failures for self-healing |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Core playbook CRUD and persistence |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval engine |
| BulletClusterer | src/playbook/clustering.py | DBSCAN clustering of bullets |
| BulletDeduplicator | src/playbook/deduplication.py | Semantic deduplication |
| DistillationRouter | src/playbook/distillation_router.py | Domain-aware routing |
| PostgresPlaybookAdapter | src/playbook/postgres_adapter.py | PostgreSQL playbook storage |
| PostgresBulletRetriever | src/playbook/postgres_retriever.py | pgvector retrieval |
| PlaybookQA | src/playbook/qa.py | Q&A system using playbook knowledge |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Logs experiments to DB |
| PlaybookRepository | src/storage/repository.py | PostgreSQL repository with pgvector |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes task outcomes |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes insights into bullets |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks with playbook context |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified LLM provider client |
| EmbeddingService | src/utils/embedding.py | Generates embeddings |
| ContextMap | src/utils/context_map.py | AST context map for code |
| ImportValidator | src/utils/import_validator.py | Validates import paths |
| AuditClient | src/audit/client.py | Write-only audit client |
| AuditStore | src/audit/store.py | Append-only audit store |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Aggregates performance metrics |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent |
| EnsembleLearner | src/ensemble/learner.py | Multi-model ensemble learning |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Main as main()
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant CycleRunner as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator
    participant PlaybookMgr as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger

    Main->>Runner: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    activate Runner
    loop for each cycle (max 12)
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        activate Planner
        Planner-->>Runner: PodSpec
        deactivate Planner

        Runner->>CycleRunner: run(spec)
        activate CycleRunner

        CycleRunner->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        activate Worker
        Worker->>LLMClient: generate(prompt)
        LLMClient-->>Worker: code
        deactivate Worker
        Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
        activate Orchestrator
        Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate Orchestrator
        Pod-->>CycleRunner: red_result
        deactivate Pod

        alt RED aborted (security)
            Note right of CycleRunner: exits if ForbiddenImport or SecurityBreach
            CycleRunner-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=False)
        else RED passed
            loop up to max_green_attempts
                CycleRunner->>Pod: run_green(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error)
                activate Worker
                Worker->>LLMClient: generate(prompt)
                LLMClient-->>Worker: code
                deactivate Worker
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
                activate Orchestrator
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                deactivate Orchestrator
                Pod-->>CycleRunner: green_result
                deactivate Pod
                alt GREEN passed
                    break
                else GREEN failed
                    Note right of CycleRunner: retry with error feedback
                end
            end
            alt GREEN passed
                CycleRunner->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
                activate Orchestrator
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                deactivate Orchestrator
                Pod-->>CycleRunner: refactor_result
                deactivate Pod

                opt learning enabled
                    CycleRunner->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen, env)
                    activate Reflector
                    Reflector-->>CycleRunner: ReflectorOutput
                    deactivate Reflector
                    CycleRunner->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                    activate Curator
                    Curator->>PlaybookMgr: apply_delta(delta_bullets)
                    activate PlaybookMgr
                    PlaybookMgr-->>Curator: added_bullets
                    deactivate PlaybookMgr
                    Curator-->>CycleRunner: CuratorOutput
                    deactivate Curator
                end
            end
            CycleRunner->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
            activate Logger
            Logger-->>CycleRunner: logged
            deactivate Logger
            CycleRunner-->>Runner: CycleResult
        end
        deactivate CycleRunner
        Runner-->>Main: IterativeResult
    end
    deactivate Runner
```
